svg.title: How a run spends its batch
svg.desc: A document to export or move is skipped when the batch is full or Nextcloud cannot store files. Otherwise it takes a place in the batch. With the conflict policy skip, a file in the way that is not the app's own copy is reported as a conflict without a download. Otherwise the document is downloaded and written, or moved. A failure is reported, and the document waits behind the others in the next run; a full quota, a read-only or an unavailable storage also ends the exports of the run.
